title: Honour the Goddess
line: For being held, for seeing the sacred in everything.
intro: The Goddess, Devi, is the power that lives in all beings: consciousness, peace, compassion, even sleep and hunger. This practice honours her in her many forms, and in you.
offering: Flowers, a lamp, a kind act done in her name.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a real diya if you have one, or this one. Let the flame be the centre of your attention for a moment.

steps.title: Take refuge
steps.text: One of the most loved verses to the Goddess: she is auspiciousness itself, and a refuge.

steps.title: See her in all beings
steps.text: Read the refrain, and then as many of her forms as you like, slowly: the Goddess who is consciousness, peace, compassion, mother, in all beings.

steps.title: Repeat the verse
steps.text: Repeat it as many times as feels true.

steps.title: Where is she today?
steps.prompt: Where did I see her today: in whom, or in what?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Fridays and the nine nights of Navratri are especially hers.
